notes.title: TENDY 1.1 Update
notes.content:
TENDY 1.1 PATCH NOTES

- Adjusted some journal entries & ordering
- Added guiding text in certain circumstances
- Added an auto-build option to levels 1-2 and 1-3
- Added additional hotkeys for submit and undo actions
- Fixed a bug on 3-3 journal entry "Plans"
- Fixed some audio bugs
- Slightly adjusted level 1-1 to leave less room for failure
